The '''''Darklight''''' was an [[Imperious-class Star Destroyer|''Imperious''-class Star Destroyer]] that served [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire|Sith Empire]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]].

==History==
On order from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the ''Darklight'' was sent to [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]] to [[Bombing of Falleen|bombard]] the populace into submitting to Sith Imperial demands. However, the Imperial vessel was attacked by a strike force consisting of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and the [[Mynock/Legends|''Mynock'']]. The smuggler vessel snuck past the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer's]] defenses, unloading two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Cade Skywalker]] and his old master [[Wolf Sazen]], into one of its hangars and took off again. The two made their way to the [[Reactor/Legends|reactor core]] of the ship, rigging it with explosives, and then made their way back to the hangar to steal two [[Predator-class fighter|''Predator''-class starfighters]].
As the ship exploded, its burning structure fell onto a mountain on the planet.

Skywalker was later rewarded for his actions by the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Grand Hutt Council/Legends|Grand Council]] member [[Vedo Anjiliac Atirue]].
